The Ti-6Al-4Mo-4Zr-2Sn-1W-0.2Si titanium alloy ingot was melted using a 650 kg vacuum consumable furnace in triplicate
After melting, the ingot was held at 1100 °C for 4 h
then forged into a rod billet φ 65 mm × 1.5 m in size at a temperature of at least 900 °C through repeated upsetting and drawing
One part was subjected to double annealing treatment: consisting of isothermal treatment at 950 °C for 2 h, air cooling (AC), and subsequent annealing at 540 °C for 6 h, under AC.
the other part was used to prepare pre-alloyed powders for LDED via the plasma rotating electrode method
The prepared powders were screened to ensure that the particle diameter was in the range of 53 – 150 μ m.
